EHL SBP Group 36 for HFTP · Deliverable 7 · prototype ·

Hotel AI register

List every AI tool your hotel uses. For each one, see its label under the EU AI Act, what to check and by when, and who is responsible.

Not legal advice. The register gives items to check, never a verdict that a hotel complies. Labels follow the EU AI Act text as checked on 17 Nov 2026, starting from the briefing booklet "AI Governance for European Hotels"; where they differ from the booklet, the register says so. Several rest on draft Commission guidance and are marked so.
